themes_detail.label: Sanitation Crisis Reversal
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints plummeted 46% THIS WEEK to 25 complaints vs. 46.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: -5.61), suggesting either a sudden intervention, reporting failure, or genuine improvement—needs verification given this is the district's fifth-highest complaint category by volume.
evidence: 25 unsanitary complaints THIS WEEK vs. 46.0 weekly average (46% drop, z-score: -5.61)
Unsanitary Condition ranks #5 in 90-day complaint volume (546 total complaints)
Timing coincides with potential city sanitation policy shift or community intervention
reporting_angles: Did a specific sanitation initiative or enforcement action launch this week? Interview Sanitation Dept.
Are residents under-reporting due to 311 outage or reduced awareness, or is there genuine improvement? Survey neighborhoods.

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retail Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints spiked 300% last week with 7 complaints vs. 1.8 weekly average (z-score: 4.82), signaling emerging neighborhood friction around legal retail expansion—potentially tied to Constellation CB16 rezoning now in City Council review.
evidence: 7 cannabis retailer complaints last week vs. 1.8 weekly average (300% spike, z-score: 4.82)
Constellation CB16 rezoning currently in City Council Review phase, likely to enable retail expansion
Pattern suggests resident backlash to retail concentration or operational issues
reporting_angles: How many cannabis retailers are currently licensed in Brownsville/Ocean Hill? Map complaints against retail locations.
Are residents complaining about odor, loitering, or zoning concerns? Interview complainants and nearby businesses.

themes_detail.label: Waste Collection Breakdown
themes_detail.summary: Missed collection complaints exploded 700% two weeks ago with 13 complaints vs. 1.6 weekly average (z-score: 10.24), the highest statistical deviation in the dataset—indicates possible sanitation worker shortage, route disruption, or equipment failure in the district.
evidence: 13 missed collection complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.6 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 10.24, highest severity)
Follows typical pattern of service disruptions caused by workforce or fleet issues in outer-borough districts
May correlate with the 46% drop in unsanitary complaints THIS WEEK if collection finally resumed
reporting_angles: What caused the collection failure 2 weeks ago? Check DSNY incident reports, union bulletins, or equipment logs.
Have collections normalized this week, or are residents still experiencing delays? Track current 311 filing rate.

themes_detail.label: Tree Damage and Overgrowth Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage and overgrown tree complaints combined for 1400-1500% spikes three weeks ago (4 and 5 complaints vs. 0.2 and 0.5 baselines; z-scores: 8.66 and 6.36), likely triggered by recent storms or deferred Parks maintenance—affects public safety and streetscape.
evidence: Illegal tree damage: 4 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.2 baseline (1500% spike, z-score: 8.66)
Overgrown tree/branches: 5 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.5 baseline (900% spike, z-score: 6.36)
Timing suggests weather event or Parks Department maintenance backlog as root cause
reporting_angles: Did a storm pass through 3-4 weeks ago, or is there a Parks Department crew shortage? Check weather records and Parks staffing.
What is the current tree trimming backlog in CD316? File FOIL request for maintenance queue data.

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Complaints Emerge
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints spiked 500% two weeks ago with 6 complaints vs. 1.0 weekly average (z-score: 4.08), suggesting either a cluster of health violations or concentrated enforcement in the district.
evidence: 6 food establishment complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.0 weekly average (500% spike, z-score: 4.08)
Aligns with Constellation CB16 rezoning activity, which may enable new food retail
Complaints likely triggered by specific violations (sanitation, pest, temperature) rather than new openings
reporting_angles: Which food establishments were cited 2 weeks ago? Cross-reference Health Dept. inspection records with 311 complaints.
Are violations concentrated in one neighborhood block or dispersed across the district?
